summary: Iteration 6 e-Procurement testing (both backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 15 passed, 1 skipped (no approved vendor with `code` field for bulk-import happy path). All 6 features work end-to-end: (a) Invoice filter+search+group-by, (b) Mandatory Faktur Pajak + BAST enforcement (400 with proper Indonesian error message), (c) Line-item validation (qty > remaining, invalid item_index, zero qty all rejected), (d) Invoice PDF export (branded PDF, 4-byte %PDF header verified, 404 on missing), (e) Bulk PO Import (endpoint parses CSV, groups by vendor/type/currency, returns created+errors, vendor role forbidden), (f) Cheapest verified pricelist (only_verified filter respected, shape stable when empty). Playwright verified: vendor invoices toolbar (vi-search+vi-groupby show grouped section headers with counts), invoice creation dialog with faktur/bast/attachment uploads and line-item picker, admin /invoices inv-groupby + per-row invoice-pdf-<id> buttons (3 buttons for 3 invoices), /po Bulk Import dialog with po-bulk-file drag-drop and po-bulk-result showing errors.

issues: Data row cells (invoice number, PO, vendor, amount) have very low contrast — appear almost invisible against dark background. Only group headers and status badges are readable in dark mode.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_invoice_extras.py bulk-import: rows list uses `_csv.DictReader` which won't strip BOM if 'utf-8-sig' fails; currently OK. Good.

routes_vendor_portal.py submit_invoice: `payload.amount` is server-recomputed as `computed_amount`, but the doc stores `payload.amount or computed_amount` — allows client to override. Consider always storing `computed_amount` as canonical `amount` to prevent client tampering.
InvoicesFinance.jsx (line 71) uses shadcn Select for group-by; page also mixes native `<select>` elsewhere — visible on the dark screenshot as unstyled dropdown. Consistency fix recommended.

VendorPortal.jsx line 817 filters PO list by ['sent','completed','partial','approved'] — but PO with `status='partial'` may not exist (partial is `invoice_status`). Confirm that fresh POs available for invoice creation aren't filtered out.
